ownerReview.review: KJV remaining New Testament complete-context review

edits.reason: Exact modern wording preserves the full verse meaning and grammar.

evidence.label: Complete-verse KJV, NKJV, NIV, ESV and NRSVUE control

edits.expected: But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.
edits.reason: The complete verse preserves earlier approved edits and the newly reviewed contextual clarifications.
edits.replacement: But whoso keepeth his word, in him truly is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.

edits.reason: Modern no before a noun and cause of stumbling, not a social occasion. Keeps in him without deciding whose stumbling is envisioned.

edits.expected: the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes
edits.replacement: the desires of the flesh, and the desires of the eyes
edits.reason: Desire here includes sensual/material coveting, not sexual lust exclusively. Both members and pride of life remain distinct.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.reason: Same desires of the world, not merely sexual lust; remains parallel to the passing world and abiding doer of God’s will.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.reason: Unction is anointing from the Holy One, as already called in27; not affected speech or an unexplained ointment. All things of this base is retained.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.reason: Deceiving about truth in context, not sexual seduction only; no insertion of new class of deceiver.

edits.expected: But whoso hath this world’s good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?
edits.replacement: But whoso hath this world’s possessions, and seeth his brother have need, and closes his heart of compassion to him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?
edits.reason: Good means possessions, not moral goodness. Keeps prior heart/compassion image and corrects preposition of closing heart toward a needy brother; not a return to obscure bowels.

edits.reason: Torment here concerns punishment in the judgment context of17. Keeps severity and love/fear argument without equating every human anxiety with wrongdoing.

edits.expected: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one.
edits.replacement: For there are three that bear witness in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Spirit: and these three are one.
edits.reason: Record is testimony, as witness in8–9. Preserves the entire heavenly witnesses clause of KJV and already approved Holy Spirit, without importing an omission from another textual tradition.

edits.expected: the record that God gave of his Son
edits.replacement: the testimony that God gave of his Son
edits.reason: Testimony about the Son, not an audio recording or statistical record; self-witness and faith remain.
